title: 50 Best AI Couple Photo Prompts
excerpt: Discover practical AI prompts for realistic, cinematic and creative couple photos.
content: A strong couple-image prompt should describe the subjects, pose, setting, lighting and photographic style while leaving enough room for the image model to produce a natural result.

When reference photos are involved, explicitly ask the model to preserve recognizable facial identity, natural proportions and authentic expressions. Avoid stacking unnecessary adjectives that do not change the visual outcome.
Start with one of the CreateLoom prompts, then customize the environment, wardrobe, camera perspective and mood to match your Reel or personal concept.

title: Best AI Selfie Prompts for Realistic Photos
excerpt: Use these prompt-writing principles to create believable AI selfies without losing the subject's identity.
content: Realistic selfie prompts work best when they specify camera perspective, natural lighting, authentic expressions and believable surroundings.

If you use a reference photo, make identity preservation an explicit requirement. Facial structure, skin tone, hairstyle and natural proportions should remain consistent unless the creative concept intentionally changes them.
For Instagram content, keep the concept visually understandable in one glance. A clear pose, environment and mood usually outperform a prompt overloaded with conflicting directions.

title: Instagram Reel Ideas for AI Creators
excerpt: Turn AI image concepts into repeatable Reel formats that are easy for viewers to understand and share.
content: AI creators can build repeatable Reel formats instead of reinventing every post. Show the final image first, reveal the prompt, demonstrate a transformation, or compare two prompt variations.
Keep the opening focused on the result. Then give viewers a clear reason to watch until the prompt reveal or final transformation.
CreateLoom prompt pages can become the destination behind each Reel, giving viewers a simple way to copy the exact prompt you used.

title: How to Get More Views on Instagram Reels
excerpt: A practical framework for stronger hooks, retention, packaging and repeatable Reel formats.
content: Start with a clear visual hook. For AI content, showing the finished transformation immediately can make the concept understandable before the viewer reads any text.
Build a repeatable format so viewers know what to expect. Examples include prompt reveals, before-and-after transformations, side-by-side generations and themed prompt series.
Review your analytics regularly and focus on patterns rather than a single Reel. Strong concepts can be repackaged with a new hook, opening frame or topic.

title: How to Get Your First Brand Deal on Instagram
excerpt: A beginner-friendly guide to positioning your creator profile, pitching brands and presenting collaboration options.
content: Brands need to understand your audience, content style and the value you can provide. A focused creator profile is easier to evaluate than a profile with no clear content direction.
Before pitching, prepare a simple media kit with audience information, recent performance, content examples and collaboration formats. You do not need a huge following to communicate professionally.
Keep outreach concise and specific. Explain why the brand fits your content, propose a concrete idea and make the next step easy for the brand contact.

title: How to Write Better AI Image Prompts
excerpt: A practical framework for turning a rough visual idea into a clear, controllable AI image prompt.
content: A useful image prompt usually has a subject, action or pose, environment, lighting, camera or composition direction and desired visual style.
Put the most important constraints near the beginning. If identity preservation matters, state it directly rather than relying on the model to infer it.
Iterate one variable at a time. Changing the setting, then the lighting, then the composition makes it easier to understand what improved the result.
